notes.title: About new projects
notes.content:
Hey, guys!

I'm an artist Let`s not stay friends and Sounds of Verity. A few years ago, our duo. 
Violet Feature broke up, so now I work alone and under a different name [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/vorobushek]Vorobushek[/url].
I want to tell you what I do, what projects I do. Yeah, I'm still making otome. Well, in case someone lost us, I thought I'd tell them I'm still here =D
I won't take up too much time, I'll just list what's available.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1268200/Espresso_For_The_Demon/]Espresso For The Demon[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31309903/1bfdac30ae2e084c0ec413acf3146fba77681c64.jpg[/img]

The project was released last year. The genre is casual with a dash of mysticism. Three characters as the love interest. First time trying this genre, the experience is challenging but interesting~

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2111200/Bride_Of_Darkness/]Bride Of Darkness[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31309903/56974c81bdae5f0d3642c70eb6e9a121cef16cb4.jpg[/img]

The game is in early access and is being released chapter by chapter. Five chapters are out now, with a sixth in progress. The project is coming along quite briskly and I have to say I'm really enjoying working in this setting and genre. There are also three characters as a love interest.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2345700/_/]Heart Of Nadia[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31309903/51396dcd17894e4867c5332e2a8db46b0b8346a7.jpg[/img]

And this is a future project, with a demo planned for the fall. As a love interest... oh, how unexpected! Three characters =D I hope it will be bright and interesting. 
Add it to your Wishlist~

I hope I've piqued your interest in something~
See you later!

notes.title: Bride Of Darkness First Chapter Release
Release Soul Light
notes.content:
Hello!
Our team, consisting of an artist, has released a short novel in the GL genre.

Kaya is a simple herbalist who denies her magic. But her native forest began to die, and only she can save it. In this she will be helped by a tribeswoman named Hary and an unfamiliar witch Anna, pursuing her goals.
Can Kaya save the forest and not die herself?

* Two opposite love interests
* Various endings
* Vibrant illustrations

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677890/Soul_Light/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31309903/819487ad877337887ac0ff498a702221c3fc692f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Release Mind Rite!
notes.content: An otome novell has been released with my participation as an artist of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1562870/Mind_Rite/]Mind Rite[/url]! Look, add to your wishlist, play, write reviews ~ While the game has a discount in honor of the release.

notes.title: Mind Rite
notes.content:
Aina is a young investigator in a distant city in the north, but when mysterious magical murders begin to take place in it, it is she and her partner who are entrusted with the case. But what if everything is not what it seems? What if Aina itself become a victim?

Features:
~ Three romanceable characters
~ Many unique endings
~ Colorful illustrations
~ Original soundtrack

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1562870/Mind_Rite/

notes.title: Update of the English version
notes.content: Hi guys! We are pleased to inform you that the English version of "Let`s not stay friends" has been edited by Chudah. The quality of translation has increased significantly and some points in the text have been changed. We apologize for what was before, and we hope that now the game will bring you even more fun. Play with pleasure!
